subject: Catalyst Workshop: staggered arrival & flight handoffs
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jenn Park <jenn@travelco.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalyst Workshop: staggered arrival & flight handoffs

Hi Jenn / team,

We’re finalizing logistics for the Catalyst onsite (May 12-13). We have a tight window for the first half-day session and multiple execs arriving on separate flights. Can you confirm the following and propose a simple handoff plan?

Key constraints:
- Arrival window: most folks land between 07:30–10:30 PDT. We need at least two shuttle runs morning-of with an on-call driver for late arrivals.
- Two VVIPs (Oliver Yang and one aide) need separate car transfers and a 30-minute buffer to the venue.
- Group of 8 engineers should be on one van if possible to reduce headcount at check-in.

Requested deliverables from TravelCo by EOD Tuesday:
1) A suggested staggered pickup schedule by arrival time (CSV) matching attendee roster.
2) Confirmation of capacity for 2 shuttles + 1 dedicated sedan (VVIP).
3) ETA buffers and contingency plan if flight is delayed >45 minutes.

I’ve attached the current draft itinerary and attendee roster (v3) — names and frequent flyer numbers redacted for privacy. Please mark required seat/vehicle assignments inline.

Also CC’ing Laura and Marcus from Ops — Laura, Marcus: if the vendor suggests overlaps that conflict with the venue load-in (08:30–09:30), I’ll need you to assign on-site contacts who can stagger check-in.

Thanks,

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Program Manager, Field Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: itinerary_draft.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB stub), attendee_roster_v3.csv (csv, 12KB stub)

From: Jenn Park <jenn@travelco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Workshop: staggered arrival & flight handoffs

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the detail. We can do the shuttle cadence + VVIP sedan. Attached is a proposed pickup CSV (we included gate info where available). Highlights:
- Shuttle A (van, 12 pax) -> 07:20 pickup for flights arriving 07:30–08:15 (will stage at Terminal 1 curb).
- Shuttle B (van, 10 pax) -> 08:40 pickup for flights arriving 08:50–09:30.
- VVIP sedan (sedan+driver) -> flexible pickup; we request the VVIP pager number and a 10-minute phone check before dispatch.

Contingencies if flight delayed >45m:
- Driver will wait up to 60 minutes from scheduled ETA for domestic flights; after that we request permission to reallocate the seat to reduce idle time.
- For guests exceeding the 60-minute mark we will dispatch the on-call vehicle at a flat override fee (included in appendix).

We noted one late arrival for Oliver Yang (arrivals pushed to 11:05) — we recommend the sedan for him with a 30-minute buffer to venue.

I can update the itinerary PDF with pickup times and send a final version tomorrow.

Jenn
Jenn Park
Account Lead — Corporate Travel Solutions
TravelCo

Attachment: travelco_pickups_proposal.csv (csv, 4KB stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Jenn Park <jenn@travelco.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Catalyst Workshop: staggered arrival & flight handoffs

Perfect — thanks Jenn. A couple of operational notes from venue side:

- Load-in window is 08:00–09:00. We can accept up to 3 simultaneous drop-offs at the main lobby doors; after 09:00 we’ll need people to use secondary entry which adds ~6 minutes per group.
- Please prioritize Shuttle A for the engineering group (8 pax) and reserve a second van as backup. Marcus, can you confirm we have 2 people at the main lobby at 07:45 for guest direction?
- For VVIPs: security escort will meet the sedan inside the lobby — Oliver’s escort will be lined up with badge access. Neha — can you confirm escort name?

Camila — once Jenn posts the updated itinerary (with pickup times), I’ll create a one-page arrival brief for the on-site hosts and badge desk.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Onsite Logistics
Redwood Inference
